lines.beaver_en: Did you pick a destination for this vacation?
lines.en: Not yet. I don't know where to go.

lines.beaver_en: How about going overseas? Japan is close too.
lines.learner: 해외는 좋기는 하지만 돈이 많이 들어요.
lines.en: Overseas is nice, but it costs a lot.
lines.roman: haeoeneun jokineun hajiman doni mani deureoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then what about the seaside? Busan's sea is pretty.
lines.en: The seaside is pretty, but it's crowded.
Daegu might be too hot in summer.

lines.beaver_en: There are lots of places to see in Ulsan.
lines.learner: 울산은 가 봤어요. 안 가 본 곳이 좋아요.
lines.en: I've been to Ulsan. I'd prefer somewhere I haven't been.
lines.roman: ulsaneun ga bwasseoyo. an ga bon gosi joayo.

lines.beaver_en: Then Daejeon? It's an hour by train.
lines.learner: 대전은 가깝기는 하지만 볼 게 있을지 모르겠어요.
lines.en: Daejeon is close, but I'm not sure there's much to see.
lines.roman: daejeoneun gakkapgineun hajiman bol ge isseulji moreugesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 대전에는 옛 건물이 있는 관광지도 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Daejeon has attractions with old buildings.
lines.beaver_roman: daejeoneneun yet geonmuri inneun gwangwangjido isseoyo.
lines.learner: 그래요? 그런데 묵을 호텔이 있을지 모르겠어요.
lines.en: Really? But I'm not sure there's a hotel to stay at.
lines.roman: geuraeyo? geureonde mugeul hoteri isseulji moreugesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: It's fine. If we hurry, we can book one.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 그럼 오늘 계획을 세울 시간 있어요?
lines.en: Okay. Then do you have time to make a plan today?
lines.roman: joayo. geureom oneul gyehoegeul seul sigan isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 네. 그런데 한강도 가고 싶다고 했죠?
lines.beaver_en: Yes. But you said you wanted to go to the Han River too?
lines.beaver_roman: ne. geureonde hangangdo gago sipdago haetjyo?
lines.learner: 네, 한강은 서울에 돌아와서 갈 거예요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll go to the Han River after we're back in Seoul.
lines.roman: ne, hangangeun seoure dorawaseo gal geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 그럼 첫 여행지는 대전으로 해요!
lines.beaver_en: Great. Then our first destination is Daejeon!
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. geureom cheon nyeohaengjineun daejeoneuro haeyo!
lines.en: Yes! I'll look up food to eat in Daejeon too.
